g.text: Ten digits, seen from the readable side
Arm 1 · medium acceleration setting · median-UNC repetition per digit · purple → orange follows elapsed time
Front view = −recorded EE y; raw positions unchanged. Gray = travel. Blue dot / gold square = first / last displayed writing pose.
